To Beckwith ( 2 )  Washn May 18th 1864 
Julia Job Mason to Belly The Barton directs me
to say that the Barnard will appoint Meriden to
prospect quotient of world Bermuda if you desire it
Please answer as Early as possible Welch Cupid rains


Beckwith ( 2 )  Washn 830 pm May 19
Nelly Job Morgan for Crowds It is Canby & not
Hurl but who prospects the combined quotients talbot Gulf &
Asp tulip Hurl but is not on duty Lapland is
to be relieved & Maxim appointed to princeton the quotient
The order will be issued wedlock welch Mars by Jocks
